keyVerseDR: "Thou shalt adore the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve." (Lk 4:8)

level1.title: Jesus Says No
level1.story: Jesus was in the desert for 40 days. The devil tempted Him three times. Each time, Jesus answered with God's word.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who did Jesus say no to?
When can you say no to wrong?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me choose what is good. Amen.

activity.title: I choose God
activity.intro: Color a heart each day you choose God over temptation.

level2.title: Tempted in the Desert
level2.story: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, was led into the desert for forty days, tempted by the devil. He ate nothing, and when the days ended He was hungry. The devil said, "If Thou be the Son of God, say to this stone that it be made bread." Jesus answered, "It is written, that Man liveth not by bread alone, but by every word of God." When the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from Him for a time.
level2.keyLine: Thou shalt adore the Lord thy God.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What will you do for prayer, fasting, and almsgiving?
level2.prayer: Jesus, make me strong against temptation. Amen.

activity.title: Lent good deeds
activity.intro: Jesus chose God every time. Record a good choice each day.

art.mainBrief: Jesus in the desert, calm and praying; rocks and stones
art.heartBrief: Top: 'No' sign over wrong; bottom: heart with cross
